threat_event: Card data is skimmed by malware at the 30 stores outside P2PE
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Older terminals send card data in clear to store POS servers before encryption
existing_controls: Segmented CDE; EDR on POS servers; file integrity monitoring

threat_event: An attacker on the store Wi-Fi management network reaches POS lanes
threat_source: External attacker in a store or via a compromised access point
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2026 segmentation test found a permitted path in one store network design used at 12 stores
existing_controls: Firewall rules at other stores; P2PE in most of the 12 stores
treatment_plan: Fix the ACL template; re-test segmentation at all 12 stores (POAM-020)

threat_event: A malicious script on the online checkout page captures card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inventory and authorization of scripts on the payment page incomplete; no tamper detection
existing_controls: Hosted payment fields; content security policy in report-only mode
treatment_plan: Script inventory with justification; tamper detection; enforce content security policy (POAM-021)

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over loyalty accounts and steals rewards
regulatory_driver: FTC Act Section 5 (N44-45-R02); state breach laws

vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large reporting exports to analysts' workspaces
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (each state where affected individuals reside)

threat_event: Store case and walk-in alerts stop reaching store staff
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group alert integration server; case controllers on general store networks
regulatory_driver: State and local food code temperature rules (generic)

threat_event: Ransomware on store back-office servers halts ordering and time clocks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Store servers joined to the corporate domain
treatment_plan: Tier store servers in PAM; restore drill
owner: Grocery Retail security and compliance lead

threat_event: Skimming overlays are placed on self-checkout terminals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Device inspections missed at 9 stores in the 2026 sample
treatment_plan: Inspection tracking in the store app with escalation

threat_event: Loss-prevention camera analytics collect or use shopper data unfairly or beyond notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot at 12 stores started without privacy review
treatment_plan: Privacy review and conditions in P10 before expansion

threat_event: Meat-counter grinding records are lost or incomplete when a ground beef trace-back is requested
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Electronic logs on store scales with no central copy at 40 stores

threat_event: Guest Wi-Fi is abused for illegal activity
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Open guest network with captive portal
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Grocery Retail security and compliance lead
owner: Grocery Retail security and compliance lead

threat_event: A payment processor outage stops card acceptance
Phishing of store managers leads to gift card fraud
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gift card activation by phone requests
treatment_plan: Activation only through the POS with manager approval

threat_event: A delivery partner exposes customer order and address data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Order data shared with three delivery partners
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (each state where affected individuals reside)
treatment_plan: Security terms and annual reviews for delivery partners

threat_event: A self-checkout software vulnerability is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Self-checkout patches lag the vendor by 60 to 90 days
treatment_plan: Patch within 30 days for critical updates

threat_event: Price files sent to POS are manipulated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Price file approval by one person in some regions

threat_event: A workforce member looks up loyalty records out of curiosity or for misuse
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customer service tool shows full purchase history
regulatory_driver: State breach laws; FTC Act Section 5 (N44-45-R02)
treatment_plan: Mask purchase history; quarterly access review

threat_event: Personalized offers make sensitive inferences about shoppers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Offer model uses full purchase history
